subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 9.**
solution:
The correct answer is: before

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning and use of the given words. 
 
 
• **Early** can be used as an adjective or an adverb which means near the beginning of a period of time, a piece of work, a series, etc.
 
• **Into** refers to a position in or inside something.
 
• Later means after the present, expected, or usual time.
 
• **Before** means earlier than somebody/something or earlier than the actual time.
 
 

 
• As adverbs the difference between **before **and **early**. is that **before **is at an earlier time while **early **is at a time before expected; sooner than usual.
 
• **Early **is used to compare things or times. We cannot use "early dusk" as it is grammatically meaningless.
 
• So, as per the uses of the given words 'before' is the most appropriate word.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: "**However, in modern times, darkness arrives at HKV hours before sunset.**"

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete passage: *On Hauz Khas Road, at the entrance to the pedestrianised Hauz Khas Village, the guard (1) at __the barrier asks you to halt and directs __(2) you__ to the parking lot. It's 5 p.m. and the parking lot is nearly empty as shops are closed and there are __(3) hardly__ any shoppers. There aren't many people on the lane leading to the __(4) residential__ area either. This is unusual for HKV (as it is popularly known) __(5) because __it is one of Delhi's popular shopping areas. Initially a hub for designer __(6) clothes__, the HKV experience __(7) had become__ a throbbing mix of cafes, art galleries, curio shops, gyms and, of course, fashion boutiques. The quirky neighbourhood was a hit__ ____(8) particularly__ with youngsters and tourists for its happening nightlife. These days however, night comes hours __**(9) before**__ dusk at HKV as you can only see street dogs, security guards, a few takeaway joint managers and bored attendants (10)________ to reach home early.*
